title: Construction of the bounded flat union complex
statement: Let p:Y→B be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let B and A be affine schemes, let g:A→B, let U,V be opens of Y, and let N be a quasi-coherent module on U∪V flat over B. Suppose StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen(p,g,T) holds for T=U,V,U∩V [def-pc-standard-single-flat-counit-presentation-on-open]. Use the standard derived categories of module sheaves. There is a bounded-above termwise flat complex K of module sheaves on B and an isomorphism e:R((U∪V)→B)_*(N[0])≅Q(K). Only the base direct image is represented; no pullback isomorphism or counit equation is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingleFlatCounitUnionCore
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    [IsAffine B] [IsAffine A] (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hN : N.IsFlatOver ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p))
    (hPU : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U)
    (hPV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g V)
    (hPUV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊓ V)) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard A.Modules
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard B.Modules
    ∃ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings B.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
      (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (K.X i)) ∧
      Nonempty (((schemeDerivedDirectImage ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K)))
